item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Crispy chicken gyoza with jasmine rice tossed with edamame and carrot, topped with spring onion. Served with a warm miso soup, sunomono (Japanese cucumber salad) and gyoza dipping sauce. Also available gluten free. (1+7+8+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Crispy vegetable gyoza with jasmine rice tossed with edamame and carrot, topped with spring onion. Served with a warm miso soup, sunomono (Japanese cucumber salad) and gyoza dipping sauce. Also available gluten free, and vegan. (1+7+8+13+15)
